body_en: Morning time is quiet and useful. Ten minutes of review before class can save an hour at night. Carry a small notebook for mistakes you keep making. If a passage feels long, mark the topic sentence of each paragraph first. Learning is a habit: same place, same time, small goal — then stop and rest.
body_zh: 清晨安静又好用。课前十分钟复习，晚上能省下一小时。随身带小本，记下反复犯的错。篇章太长时，先标出每段主题句。学习是习惯：同一地点、同一时间、小目标——然后停下来休息。
